name: Human
description: Adaptable and ambitious, humans are capable of reaching great heights.

name: Elf
description: Ancient beings with a connection to magic and nature.

name: Dwarf
description: Resilient people known for endurance and craftsmanship.

name: Halfling
description: Small, resourceful folk whose courage and luck routinely carry them through danger.

name: Gnome
description: Inventive and curious people with an instinct for magic, mechanisms, and hidden possibilities.

name: Orc
description: Powerful survivors with fierce determination and a deep cultural respect for strength and endurance.

name: Tiefling
description: A lineage touched by infernal power, often marked by horns, unusual eyes, and innate magic.

name: Dragonborn
description: Draconic humanoids whose heritage grants elemental resilience and a devastating breath weapon.

name: Half-Elf
description: People who blend human adaptability with elven senses, charm, and a connection to the fey.

name: Goliath
description: Towering mountain-born warriors known for endurance, competition, and imposing physical presence.
